name: SKA Capital Berhad
overview: SKA Capital Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所ACE市场完成首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行168,075,500股新股。公司业务线未发生变动，公告中未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: SKA Capital Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026, with a public issue of 168,075,500 new ordinary shares. There were no changes to the company's business lines, and no specific operational changes for each business segment were disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE市场上市，业务线未发生变动。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026, with no changes to its business lines.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF SKA CAPITAL BERHAD ("SKA CAPITAL" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURS
actions.text: 完成首次公开募股，公开发行168,075,500股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: Completed initial public offering, with a public issue of 168,075,500 new shares and listing on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
